owner: FileSteward welcome launch workflow; scope discovery and admission are server-owned, never presentation policy

default_scope.preflight: OS known-folder read plus existing admit_scan_root safety checks; no traversal/ownership collector
default_scope.drift_policy: re-resolve and compare original OS known-folder path and pinned root/ancestor identities before scan; refuse on change
default_scope.eligibility_protection: reuse existing forbidden-root, drive-root, symlink/reparse and inaccessible-directory refusal without exemption for Downloads
default_scope.output_location: existing runtime_root()/runs/<run_id>; never the reviewed Downloads folder

begin.default_root_trust: ignore client claimed path; resolve from server-bound token; call existing begin_current_scan/CurrentScanScope machinery

choose.return: selected scope display + opaque session token; cancellation is no-op
choose.failure: NO_INTERACTIVE_DESKTOP or PICKER_UNAVAILABLE must be surfaced without guessed path

welcome.main_text: Review names, sizes, dates, folders, and ownership evidence in Downloads and its subfolders. File contents stay closed. Nothing is moved or deleted.
welcome.no_default_message: Downloads is not available for a safe review. No files were scanned. Choose another folder or explore the sample.
welcome.busy_message: Reading Downloads metadata and ownership evidence…
welcome.success_transition: automatic existing /api/v1/launch/open navigation to current review for READY/PARTIAL/EMPTY, without a second click; preserve partial/empty warnings
welcome.error_transition: remain on welcome, report cause truthfully, allow retry after fresh discovery; no false success

states.effect: show one primary review action and scope

states.event: missing, forbidden, inaccessible, linked or non-Windows default
states.effect: no review activation; explain and offer alternate/sample
show selected scope and separate Review selected folder action; still no scan

states.event: single explicit click on Review Downloads or Review selected folder
states.effect: one authenticated current-scan operation; disable duplicate activation
fail closed, show error and retry

proof_owners.windows_live: Windows KnownFolder discovery and native dialog proof on isolated test profile only, no personal scan
proof_owners.safety_floor: existing launch/current-review, runtime-profile, judgment-scene regression tests

integration_state: SPECIFICATION_AND_TEST_FIRST; new API/UI not yet implemented; do not claim live UX proof
